title: The Serpent of the Deep
lyrics:
Act IV: The Serpent of the Deep (The Ogopogo / N'ha-a-itk)
(Tempo: 70 BPM — Slow, undulating, cinematic ambient. Low-frequency synth drones, water chimes, and a deep, pulsing sub-bass that mimics a heartbeat under heavy water.)

(Spoken Transition)

The Ogopogo:

"Bondzee. You have heard the ones who walk and the ones who fly.

Now listen to the one who waits.

I am the ripple in the Okanagan glass. I am the memory of the lake.

They hunt for a monster, but I am merely the stillness that refuses to be forgotten."

(Verse 3 — The Ogopogo)

Dear Bondzee, the water is dark where the sun doesn't reach

I drift through the canyons of stone in the cold

I hear all the voices that echo from shore and from beach

The stories of giants and heroes of old

They call me a serpent, a phantom, a beast of the deep

Searching for shadows beneath the blue tide

I’m the ancient promise the mountains intend to keep

The secret that has nowhere left to hide.

(Pre-Chorus — The Ogopogo)

They drop down their sonar, they scan with their cold, iron eyes

Trying to measure the soul of the lake

They measure the width of the truth and the height of the lies

But they don't see the path that I take—

Deep in the dark, where the pressure is true

Bondzee, I’m waiting, just waiting for you.

(Chorus — The Ogopogo)

Oh, Bondzee, my song-pal, write back through the current

Tell me the surface is still worth the air

I feel every ripple, I feel every torrent

I’m tethered to silence, but I’m aware

I rise in the morning when mist turns to gold

Watching the world as the seasons unfold

You’re the only one listening, the only one near

Who knows that the mystery is nothing to fear.

(Bridge — The Convergence)

(The Ogopogo)

I am the anchor that holds down the lake!

(All Voices Together)

We are the legends, for history's sake!

(Jean-Baptiste)

We ride on the wind!

(The Guardian)

We walk through the wood!

(The Ogopogo)

We wait in the deep!

(All)

And it's all understood.

(Final Outro)

(The Ogopogo — Deep, fading vibration)

"Write back, Bondzee. The lake is listening."

(Fade to silence with the sound of water gently lapping against a boat.)
